title: Work-tape displacement during a run
statement: Let $M$ be a nondeterministic multi-tape Turing machine, $w$ a finite binary choice word, $c$ a configuration, and $i$ a work-tape index. The absolute difference between the position of head $i$ after running $M$ from $c$ under $w$ and its initial position is at most $|w|$.
